items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: Well, last time I seen Dutry was in Ohio. Mm-hmm. But he was still playing trombone. He was waiting in a club out there.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. Well, what about Sam Dutry, the old man? Dutry? Dutry, yeah.
Well, last time I seen Dutry was in Ohio. Mm-hmm. But he was still playing trombone. He was waiting in a club out there.
No, the clarinet clap. Oh, I don't know him. You didn't know him? I know, Dutry played trombone.
